review: I like the look: the glowing ghost, a new colour for each stage, and hazards I can read at once. First Steps is a gentle start and Crumble Bridge felt fair and tense. But Spike Garden comes second and I stood in front of a spike for 45 seconds with no way forward; 98 of 100 players failed. Spring Loaded stuck me beside a spring in the same way. Laser Gate killed me in two seconds, before I learned the rhythm. Ferry Lines dropped me in a pit while I waited for a platform. Gauntlet is a wall. I would stop playing at stage 2.
best: Crumble Bridge: clear, tense, and I can finish it.
worst: Spike Garden at stage 2 leaves almost every player stuck with no way forward.
